title: A read of a pending offline edit reports source snapshot where the contract says overlay
description: Observed live: reading a file with a pending offline edit labels source as snapshot, while docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md says overlay. Decide which is right, then reconcile the contract and the code, with a Gherkin scenario in features/computer_file_live.feature.
right_now_summary: Pending offline reads report “snapshot,” but the contract says “overlay,” so the code and docs need alignment.
